title: US-short §7 two-axis market regime governance — const-pins the market_risk_regime→cap ladder + the 3 worst_of input axes (VIX/SPY+QQQ/breadth) + unknown-severity tiers + upgrade-confirmation + two-axis policy + scope
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §7 market_risk_regime→position-cap mapping (进攻 1.0 / 震荡 0.8 / 防御 0.5 / 极度防御 0, severity-ordered) AND the design-locked input-axis + safety mechanics so a future batch-2 regime/sizing engine cannot drop QQQ, treat VIX provider-unavailable as clean/aggressive, source breadth from paid industry ETFs, weaken missing-input downgrades, or upgrade after one good week while staying schema-valid. Pins: the worst_of input set (vix/market_trend/breadth); vix_axis_policy (§3 provider-authorization-gated, unapproved-until-passed, unapproved/unavailable→unknown axis with fallback to SPY/QQQ+breadth + conservative downgrade); market_trend_axis (SPY+QQQ, QQQ required); breadth_axis (base-universe source, no paid industry ETF); the two-axis anti-worst_of policy; anti_chatter (down fast / up slow, upgrade needs 2 consecutive weekly runs or threshold buffer); unknown_degradation_policy (never default aggressive / missing-one downgrade / missing-critical at-least-defensive / severe restricted); and scope (affects sizing/new-entry/optional action_confidence; never hard-veto; never replaces per-stock analysis). Regime threshold VALUES (VIX 18/25/35 etc.) are forward priors routed to §13.1 #3, not pinned. theme_opportunity_state vocab not yet design-enumerated, intentionally NOT pinned. draft-07 cannot express: cap byte-faithfulness, descending caps, provenance of every pinned mechanic in §7, and threshold_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

market_risk_regime_caps.description: §7 — market_risk_regime → position cap, severity-ordered (进攻→极度防御), const-pinned byte-faithful.

risk_axis_components.description: §7 三类输入 — the exact worst_of component set market_risk_regime aggregates over.

vix_axis_policy.description: §7 input ① VIX — provider-authorization-gated (§3); unapproved/unavailable → unknown axis, fallback to SPY/QQQ+breadth + conservative downgrade; never treated as verified until the gate passes.

market_trend_axis.description: §7 input ② 大盘趋势 — SPY + QQQ; QQQ is REQUIRED (pool skews AI/semis/growth).

breadth_axis.description: §7 input ③ 板块/市场广度 — sourced from base-universe constituents; does NOT depend on paid industry ETFs.

two_axis_policy.description: §7 两轴拆分（关键反保守）— risk axis worst_of decides cap; theme axis separate (not worst_of); weak market + strong theme still allows low-size probe.

anti_chatter.description: §7 防抖（快防守慢进攻）— downgrade immediate; upgrade needs confirmation = 2 consecutive better weekly runs OR back above the threshold buffer.

unknown_degradation_policy.description: §7 unknown 按防御 — never default 进攻; missing one input → downgrade; missing a critical input → at least 防御; severe → restricted.

scope.description: §7 作用域 — affects sizing/new-entry/(optional)action_confidence; NEVER hard-veto; NEVER replaces per-stock analysis.

threshold_calibration_item_id.description: §7 阈值全 prior → §13.1 #3 (环境阈值: VIX 18/25/35、均线、广度线、两轴拆分阈值).
